findings.text: follow-on: the negative-control paragraph states the mutation as replacing the unpadded append with `cells.append((f"{reason:<{room}}", "dim"))`, but that edit alone does not fail the test — the empty-reason branch guards on `if reason:`, so with reason="" nothing is appended and the row still ends on a glyph (reproduced, /tmp/review_rowend_minmut.log: len=121, ends_blank=False, test would pass). The recorded control is valid — the log shows EXIT=1 and a rendered row ending in blanks — but the actual mutation must also drop the guard (revert toward the base block that pads whenever room>0). A reader following the fragment's one-line recipe would not reproduce the control.

follow-on: test_a_reason_is_truncated_to_the_room_the_grid_leaves and test_a_reason_clipped_at_the_margin_ends_on_a_word relaxed `len(...) == 180` to `<= 180` although a truncated clause fills the room, so those exact assertions were checking truncation-to-fill rather than pinning the pad and could have stayed strict; the weakening is minor because `…` presence and count are still asserted.

justifications.durability: every behaviour the measure names has a test that flips when it is reverted: restoring the base right pad reddens test_a_row_with_no_clause_ends_at_its_last_glyph at the `assert empty[-1] != " "` line (reproduced, /tmp/review_rowend_negctl.log, EXIT=1), and the alignment guarantees are asserted on the same test and on the role-column offset test.
justifications.evidence: the manifest arithmetic reproduces here: the eight named files read 146 passed EXIT=0 at head (re-run, /tmp/review_rowend_head.log) against the base arm of 145 passed 0 failed EXIT=0, both reconciling with the log summaries they cite; the base defect and the head fix reproduce directly (/tmp/review_rowend_probe.log), and the negative control's EXIT=1 reproduces when the base pad is restored (/tmp/review_rowend_negctl.log). Two minor notes keep this below full: the fragment's literal mutation recipe does not by itself reproduce the control, because the empty-reason branch guards on `if reason:` so padding the append alone leaves the row unpadded (/tmp/review_rowend_minmut.log); and one truncation assertion was relaxed from exact to at-most where it did not pin the pad.
justifications.fit: the change is minimal and idiomatic — it removes the unconditional trailing separator and the right pad, leaves `_reason` receiving the identical room (grid_width - head - GAP, unchanged before and after), and names the new test by mechanism (test_a_row_with_no_clause_ends_at_its_last_glyph); the naming checks over the 149 added lines find no banned label, and no commit carries an AI attribution.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the measure lands and is asserted: Ticker.render appends the clause at its own length and appends the two-column separator only when a clause is present, so an empty-reason row ends on its last fixed glyph. Verified independently by loading both module revisions and rendering the same blocked-with-empty-reason event: the base renders len=180 ending in 59 trailing blanks, the head renders len=121 ending on the counters glyph with 0 trailing blanks (/tmp/review_rowend_probe.log). Fixed columns keep their offsets, asserted in test_a_row_with_no_clause_ends_at_its_last_glyph (counters start and the blocked index match the clause-bearing row) and in test_a_role_column_still_leaves_every_other_column_on_its_own_position (arrow index and letter columns).
justifications.scope_discipline: the two commits touch exactly ten paths — reckon/crew/ticker.py, the eight named test files, and the node's own evidence fragment — every one inside the declared write paths; no path outside the fence is modified and the reviewed worktree is clean at head c7fbc3389.
